title: The family of the Coppa:ج ح خ‎

blocks.text: Three letters with the same body and three very different sounds: ⁧ج⁩ is familiar, ⁧خ⁩ you learn in minutes, ⁧ح⁩ It requires specific training because it is produced in the faringe, an area that the Italian does not use. This unit is the first of the Module 0.2, dedicated to difficult sounds.

rows: 6 hours · one week at a standard pace

blocks.text: Materials This unit, calligraphy L0-05, Anki deck (tag L0-05), mirror, telephone to register
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize and write ⁧ج ح خ⁩ in all forms;
2. Pronunciation ⁧ح⁩ as a pharyngal fricativa, distinct from h and ḫ;
3. Pronunciation ⁧خ⁩ with a veiled or uvular clutch, distinct from k;
4. distinguishing by ear ḥ / ḫ and ǧ / ḥ;
5. read, write and translate the words of the vocabulary, many of which are frequent in the political chronicle.
Plan of the week.
7 Correction · Anki
⁧خ⁩ ḫāʾ ( ⁧خَاء⁩ ) ḫ /x/ ~ [χ] ⁧خ⁩ ⁧خـ⁩ ⁧ـخـخـ⁩

The body is a cup: in the initial and median it is a horizontal section with a hook at the top right; in isolated and final adds a large curve that descends below the line and opens to the left. The points make the difference:

rows: one underneath (inside the cup in the isolated and final forms)

blocks.text: ⁧خ⁩ one above ḫ /x/ ~ [χ]
All three connect from both sides and are moon letters: ⁧الجَبَل⁩ al-ǧabal, ⁧الحَرْب⁩ al-ḥarb, ⁧الخَبَر⁩ al-ḫabar.
• Sound in MSA. /d͡ʒ/, affrigata postalveolare sonora: la g di "giorno" , "gentile" .
• Regional variation. In Cairo and in most of Egypt it is pronounced [g] (gamal for ǧamal); in the Levant
urban often [ʒ], the j of the French "jour" . Each speaker shall use his/her own in the reading of the MSA; you use [d͡ʒ] and learn to recognize the others.
• Examples ⁧جَدِيد⁩ ǧadīd · ⁧جَبَل⁩ ǧabal · ⁧خَلِيج⁩ ḫalīǧ (final).
It is one of the most characteristic sounds of Arabic and the most important of this unity.
• Where it is produced. In the pharynge, the part of the throat behind the root of the tongue: lower than the veil (where
is born ⁧خ⁩ ) and higher than the glottis (where the h).
• How it is produced. It is a deaf African: the air passes into a narrow farynx, without scraping. The vocal cords
They don't vibrate.
• Four-step training.
1. Blow a long and strong h, like when you hang a glass to clean it: hhhh.
2. Repeat by tightening the muscles of your throat, as if to speak in a whisper tense: feel tension on the sides of the
the neck and sound becomes more "compressed." This is ḥ.
3. Check: If you hear a scraper, your tongue has climbed up to the palate and you're doing ⁧خ⁩ ; if the sound is soft
as a hotel in English, the throat is too relaxed and you are doing h.
4. Add vowels: ḥa, ḥi, ḥu, ḥā; then the words ḥarb, ḥall, baḥr.
• Examples ⁧حَرْب⁩ ḥarb · ⁧حِزْب⁩ ḥizb · ⁧بَحْر⁩ baḥr (medial) ⁧حَلّ⁩ ḥall.
• Typical error. Pronouncing it as aspirated h, as k, or as ḫ. The minimum pairs of the section 3 serve
Just to hear them change their words.
• Sound. /x/, often [χ] is equal to deaf African with the back of the tongue near the veil or the owl, with a scrape
audible. It is the sound of the German Bach and the Spanish Jota.
• How it is produced. Start from a k and instead of closing, let the air pass between tongue and soft palate.
• Examples ⁧خَبَر⁩ ḫabar · ⁧خَلِيج⁩ ḫalīǧ · ⁧خَارِج⁩ ḫāriǧ.
• Typical error. Pronouncing k: ḫabar It is not "kabar" (s).
2.4 Three throat fricatives compared
⁧خ⁩ ḫ veil / ugol yes ḫall Vinegar
⁧ه⁩ h (L0-08) glottis no, relaxed throat ...
ǧ / ḥ ⁧جَدّ⁩ – ⁧حَدّ⁩ ǧadd – ḥadd Grandfather limit
⁧حُرّ⁩ ḥurr free ⁧ح ر ر⁩ adjective

Notes of use. ⁧حَرْب⁩ ḥarb: Female without ⁧ة⁩ · ⁧خَلِيج⁩ ḫalīǧ: ⁧الخَلِيج⁩ The Gulf ⁧خَارِج⁩ ḫāriǧ: ⁧فِي الخَارِج⁩ • Abroad • Note ⁧حَرْب⁩ : is feminine even without ⁧ة⁩ . ⁧حُدُود⁩ is the plural of ⁧حَدّ⁩ limit, boundary.
4.1 The words in context
⁧البَحْرُ الأَبْيَضُ⁩ al-baḥru l-abyaḍu The Mediterranean Sea Lett. The half-white sea ⁧المُتَوَسِّطُ⁩ mutawassiṭu
⁧حَلٌّ سِيَاسِيٌّ⁩ ḥallun siyāsiyyun a Formula solution frequent in the international political news

Writing and Keyboard
1. Calligraphy L0-05. Heals the large curve of isolated and final and the position of points.
2. Keyboard (Arabic) 101). ⁧ج⁩ = [ · ⁧ح⁩ = P · ⁧خ⁩ = O.
Script A · three sounds
. ⁧حَرْب، خَبَر⁩ . ⁧حَلّ، خَلّ⁩ . ⁧جَا، حَا، خَا⁩
Script B · minimum pairs
. ⁧حُدُود، جُدُود⁩ . ⁧جَدّ، حَدّ⁩ . ⁧حَال، خَال⁩ . ⁧حَلّ، خَلّ⁩
Script C · dictation
. ⁧خَارِج⁩ . ⁧جَنُوب⁩ . ⁧حَلّ⁩ . ⁧خَلِيج⁩ . ⁧حُدُود⁩ . ⁧جَبَل⁩ . ⁧بَحْر⁩ . ⁧جَدِيد⁩ . ⁧خَبَر⁩ . ⁧حَرْب⁩
Oral production
1. ⁧ح⁩ every day. Two minutes a day of the four steps of the section 2.2, all week and the
later.
2. Scale h ḥ – ḫ. Pronunciation has, ḥa, ḫa in sequence, five times, feeling the point rising from the glottis to
veil.
3. Couple. Read the B script aloud alternating the words of each couple.
4. Registration. Timed reading; check that ⁧ح⁩ has no scraping and that ⁧خ⁩ It's not a k. Keep the
registration: you will compare it with the end level 0.
